name: Determine costs, compare prices, and negotiate deals
description: Users asked to determine specific costs, compare value propositions, or negotiate prices for a wide range of items including consumer electronics, groceries, services, and in-game assets. The requests varied from seeking historical pricing data and market analysis to calculating transaction totals and blending negotiation tactics for purchases.
